name: What are the first steps an electrician should take to implement AEO?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps an electrician should take to implement AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: The initial steps for AEO involve optimizing your Google Business Profile with accurate and complete information, creating clear and concise service pages that directly answer common customer questions, and using structured data (schema markup) on your website. Additionally, developing FAQ sections on your site that mirror real customer inquiries and ensuring your website is mobile-friendly and loads quickly are important foundational elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin by optimizing your Google Business Profile, creating clear service pages, using schema markup, and building a comprehensive FAQ section.
